new_official_sources.title: Board of Supervisors File No. 261020 — Legislation Text, Version 1 (Proposed Admin. Code §§ 37.3(h), 37.7, 37.15(b)(2)(F))
new_official_sources.statement: Official Version 1 bill text introduced September 15, 2026 (Pending Committee Action; NOT enacted). Proposes Sec. 37.3(h) capping combined Sec. 37.3(a)(2) banked rent increases and Sec. 37.3(a)(3) capital-improvement passthroughs at 10% of the lowest base rent in effect during the 12 months preceding the effective date (leaving Sec. 37.3(a)(1) annual CPI increases separate), applicable to banked notices and CI petitions on/after September 15, 2026 through December 31, 2029, with excess amounts deferred to on/after January 1, 2030, and proposes amending Sec. 37.15(b)(2)(F) to add annual Housing Inventory reporting of whether any banked increase was imposed in the prior 12 months.

new_official_sources.title: Board of Supervisors File No. 261020 — City Attorney Legislative Digest, Version 1
new_official_sources.agency: San Francisco Office of the City Attorney / Board of Supervisors (Legistar)
new_official_sources.statement: Official September 15, 2026 Legislative Digest summarizing existing Rent Ordinance law (annual CPI increase, 24-month banking, 5%/10% capital-improvement amortization caps, Housing Inventory licensing) and confirming proposed File No. 261020 (not enacted) would cap combined banked + capital-improvement increases at 10% of lowest prior-12-month base rent through December 31, 2029 and require Housing Inventory reporting of prior-12-month banked increases.

new_official_sources.title: FY 2027 Calculation Summary of Small Area Fair Market Rents (SAFMRs) for ZIP Code 94122 (San Francisco, CA HUD Metro FMR Area)
new_official_sources.agency: U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development (HUD USER)
new_official_sources.statement: Official HUD FY 2027 Small Area FMRs for Outer Sunset ZIP Code 94122: Efficiency $2,370; 1-Bedroom $2,770; 2-Bedroom $3,410; 3-Bedroom $4,460; 4-Bedroom $5,020. Derived from 94122 ACS 5-year 40th-percentile 2BR Adjusted Standard Quality gross rent estimates ($2,610 in 2024; $2,498 inflated to $2,565 in 2023; $2,498 inflated to $2,691 in 2022; average base rent $2,622 x 1.183 recent-mover factor x 1.0352 gross-rent inflation x 1.0604 trend factor = $3,410).
